g.text: A durable directory under the default V2 retention writer
the first V2 successor is one-way: older binaries then refuse the directory or cannot extend it
every binary opens, admits and checkpoints it,
a binary that reads V2 but writes V1
adopts the directory, then refuses a successor
a binary built before the dual reader
at a V2 checkpoint descriptor, or UnknownObjectDomain
at the first anchor or radix node
No transition leads back to V1:
nothing exports V2 back to V1.
a V1 successor from a binary
first successor under the default writer:
the history migrates once, as one sorted
a path-local commit, a V2 checkpoint
